title: Waiting Time for Childcare Centre Places
what_it_is: Waiting Time for Childcare Centre Places

sections.label: Childcare vacancies and waiting times
sections.summary: Many childcare centres have vacancies for short-notice enrolment, but some high-demand estates still have waits of weeks to months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Many childcare centres now have available vacancies to enrol children at short notice.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: However, for few housing estates with high childcare demand, parents may still experience waiting times that range from a few weeks to a few months.

sections.label: Polytechnic early childhood intake increase
sections.summary: Polytechnics increased student intake for early childhood diploma courses by more than 70% last year, from 380 to 675 places.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: For example, the polytechnics have increased student intake for early childhood diploma courses by more than 70% last year, from 380 to 675 places.

sections.label: Wait list and placement factors
sections.summary: Centre vacancy, estate demand, parents' preferences and manpower requirements matter, with about 13,800 children on the wait list for February 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: For example, centre vacancy, demand in estates and parents' preferences for particular centres also matter a great deal, or manpower requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We have about 13,800 children currently registered on the wait list, requesting for a childcare place by February 2017.

sections.label: Five large childcare centres
sections.summary: Five large childcare centres are being built in Jurong West, Punggol, Sengkang, Woodlands and Yishun.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In terms of some of the other questions, whether there are more mega centres, we are building five large childcare centres in Jurong West, Punggol, Sengkang, Woodlands and Yishun.

sections.label: Four more large childcare centres
sections.summary: Four more large childcare centres in Punggol, Sengkang and Bukit Panjang will add about 2,700 places and are expected to open by end-2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We are adding four more new large childcare centres announced last month as part of our overall efforts to meet the needs of young families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: They will be in Punggol, Sengkang and Bukit Panjang, and they will add about 2,700 new places in these estates and are expected to open by the end of 2018.

sections.label: Yishun childcare landscape and space
sections.summary: Yishun is being looked at for mega and other childcare centres, and advisors are urged to support space requirements for such centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Yishun will be one area that we are looking at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: It is not just in terms of mega childcare centres but it is also in terms of the range of the other childcare centres that are part of the overall landscape.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We do urge the advisors to also support us when we do put forward requirements for use of space for some of these childcare centres to be built.
